why_next: Five consecutive model-based approaches have failed to produce a validated extrapolation of ranking agreement from n=5-20 to full-DOM n=50/82. The failures span parametric (Phi functions), functional-form (power law), and non-parametric (empirical CDF linear extrapolation) approaches. The common root cause is step-function structure (0,0,0.50,0.57) with 7.6x growth deceleration that cannot be captured by smooth or linear forms. The empirical CDF is by construction identical to the diagnostic proportion(margin>0) under template invariance and adds zero predictive information. Only Docker-based direct full-DOM measurement can empirically answer whether ranking agreement crosses 80% at n=21-82. A final bounded-function fit (logistic/Hill/Richards) to the 4-point data is low-cost and could test the saturation hypothesis, but has only 2 df and may not discriminate from linear on 4 points.
